project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router) frontend + NestJS 12 ESM backend, shared Supabase postgres + storage
build_system: Frontend: npm + Next.js 16 Turbopack. Backend: npm + NestJS CLI (tsc). Both use strict TypeScript 6.
test_framework: None found in either repo — no test command exists; verification is build-only.
build_command: npm run build (run from each repo root separately)
test_command: N/A — no test suite; use 'npm run build' as the verification step
verification_instructions: 1. In hotel-os-api: run 'npm run build' and confirm zero errors. 2. In hotel-os: run 'npm run build' and confirm zero errors.
environment_constraints: Do NOT read .env or .env.local — they contain secrets. Reference only variable names. Backend ESM: all local imports must use .js extension. ConfigModule is already global in app.module.ts — do not re-import in hotels.module.ts.
contribution_requirements: Backend: ESM .js import extensions on all local imports. No 'any' types. Use class-validator decorators for DTOs. NestJS 12 / TypeScript 6 patterns only. Frontend: 'use client' on all interactive components. Use existing apiClient from app/lib/api/client.ts for all backend calls.
key_patterns: Backend DTOs follow create-hotel.dto.ts (class-validator + @nestjs/swagger decorators). Guards: @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard) + @Roles(UserRole.HOTEL_OWNER). Controller methods call service methods with (hotelId, userId, dto) args. Frontend API modules follow dashboard.ts pattern (typed functions wrapping apiClient). CSS vars: --db-surface, --db-border, --db-muted, --db-primary, --db-secondary, --db-accent for dashboard; --ob-* for onboarding.
directory_structure: hotel-os-api/src/hotels/ — hotels controller, service, module, dto/. hotel-os/app/lib/ — api/ (client.ts, dashboard.ts, etc), auth-context.tsx. hotel-os/app/components/ — shared dashboard components. hotel-os/app/dashboard/profile/ — profile page. hotel-os/app/onboarding/ — context/, components/, steps/step-5/.
